title: Smile Tease
description: Text your partner asking them to send a 5-second video showing only their smile.

title: First Garment
description: Send a text describing the exact piece of clothing you want them to take off first tonight.

title: Soundtrack Hint
description: Text your partner a song and tell them to listen to the lyrics while thinking of you.

title: Location Tease
description: Send a voice note dropping a hint about what room in the house you want to start in tonight.

title: Kiss Count
description: Text your partner asking them to pick a random number between 1 and 10—that’s how many kisses they owe you the second you walk through the door.

title: Color Guess
description: Send a sneaky text asking them to guess what color underwear you wore today.

title: Target Practice
description: Text your partner a photo of a spot on your body where you want a kiss later.

title: Wildcard Pass
description: Send a text giving them permission to interrupt you once tonight with a passionate kiss, no matter what you are doing.

title: Single Word
description: Text your partner a single naughty word that sums up your mood today.

title: Waist Boundary
description: Send a teaser text telling your partner they aren't allowed to touch your waist until you say so.

title: Doorway Welcome
description: Meet your partner at the front door and give them a 5-second lingering kiss on the lips before saying 'welcome home.'

title: Jacket Assist
description: Gently trace your thumb over their collarbone while helping them take off their jacket or bag.

title: Kitchen Lean
description: Stand next to them while they make coffee or dinner and quietly rest your head on their shoulder for 15 seconds.

title: Red Light Hold
description: Reach across the car console and hold their hand firmly at every red light.

title: Pocket Pinch
description: Walk past your partner and slip your hand into their back pocket for a gentle squeeze.

title: Counter Contact
description: Stand close enough that your hips touch while washing dishes or preparing food.

title: Hallway Graze
description: Lightly graze your fingers down the back of their arm while walking past them in the hallway.

title: Belt Loop Pull
description: Pull your partner in by their belt loops or waistband for a quick, firm kiss.

title: Face Hold
description: Touch the side of their face with both hands and tell them they look incredible today.

title: Silent Sway
description: Hold your partner by the hips and slowly sway together for 30 seconds with no music playing.

title: Lip Bite Stare
description: Bite your bottom lip while looking at them from across the kitchen counter.

title: Breath on Cheek
description: Lean in close, pretend you are going to tell them a secret, and just breathe gently onto their cheek.

title: Silent Demand
description: Catch their eye, point to your lips, and point to them—demanding a kiss without speaking.

title: Secret Smile
description: Look at your partner, smile slowly, and shake your head like you’re holding back a secret.

title: Lip Glance
description: Pause mid-sentence while talking, look down at their lips, then look back up into their eyes before continuing.

title: Warm Look
description: Give your partner a warm, lingering look, then slowly tilt your head and smile.

title: Ear Confession
description: Whisper 'I've been distracted by you all afternoon' right against their ear.

title: Seated Collarbone
description: Stand behind them while they are seated and rest both hands lightly on their collarbones.

title: Outfitter Rule
description: Rule: The initiator gets to choose what both of you wear for the next hour.

title: Screen Blackout
description: Rule: Neither of you can use your phone for the next 30 minutes—only focus on each other.

title: Room Transit
description: Rule: You must hold hands every time you move from one room to another for the rest of the evening.

title: Kneeling Drink
description: Pour your partner a cold glass of water or a warm drink and serve it to them on your knees.

title: Mood Lighting
description: Turn off all main overhead lighting and switch to warm lamps or candlelight only.

title: Quick Foot Rub
description: Give your partner a slow 2-minute foot rub while they relax on the couch.

title: Pamper Check
description: Ask your partner: 'What's one small thing I can do tonight to make you feel completely pampered?'

title: Room Temp Shift
description: Put on a slow, ambient playlist and set the room temperature to cozy.

title: Initial Trace
description: Trace your initial onto their forearm with your fingertip and make them guess what you wrote.

title: Cold Metal Trace
description: Tell your partner to close their eyes while you lightly run a cold silver spoon down their arm.

title: Mirror Note
description: Write a romantic or playful note on their bathroom mirror using a dry-erase marker or lip balm.

title: Stress Reduction
description: Ask your partner to rate their stress level from 1 to 10 and give them a massage until it drops by two points.

title: Sweet Bite
description: Feed your partner a sweet treat (like a piece of chocolate or fruit) while holding their eyes locked with yours.

title: Trio Kisses
description: Give your partner three gentle kisses—one on the forehead, one on the tip of the nose, and one on the lips.

title: Two Buttons
description: Unbutton just the top two buttons of your partner's shirt, then step back.

title: Day Catchup
description: Trace your finger around their earlobe while asking them about the best part of their day.

title: Lap Rest
description: Sit next to your partner on the couch and rest your legs across their lap.

title: Balm Application
description: Gently apply lip balm to your partner's lips using your finger.

title: Palmed Kiss
description: Kiss the palm of their hand, close their fingers into a fist, and say 'keep that for later.'

title: Knee Rest
description: Rest your hand gently on their knee while watching TV or chatting.

title: Synced Breath
description: Stand face-to-face and take five slow, deep breaths in unison.

title: Bedroom Summon
description: Walk up, whisper 'You're mine tonight,' and walk into the bedroom.
